ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors. [T:OLE-028]
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard. [T:OLE-027]

The acidification method for homemade garlic and herb oils was developed only for garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary; it does not cover other vegetables or herbs, such as peppers or mushrooms. [T:OLE-016]

akapity: Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products. [T:OLE-024]
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for leeks in oil from a checked source. [T:-]
